item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.17
item.description:
1.0.0-beta.17

The first Scribio release delivered as an update rather than a download. If you are on beta.16, Check for Updates should find this one.

New

  • Setup now ends by telling you what it already found — permissions, your calendar, backups, and your voice with the date you enrolled it. Steps that were already done used to be dropped silently, which made a finished setup look like a skipped one.
  • Settings → About → Updates: install automatically, hold an update while a recording is running, and a line saying when Scribio last looked.
  • Check for Updates… is now in the Scribio menu and the menu bar, and About shows a Beta channel badge while beta updates are on.

Fixed

  • Your voice: "enrolled" now means a voiceprint this Mac can actually use. A profile carried over from another Mac — whose encryption key stayed behind by design — used to satisfy setup while recognising nobody. If enrolment is missing or was skipped, Scribio now says so instead of waiting for a meeting.
  • Microsoft 365 asks for your calendar only. Meeting attendance reports are requested later, if you turn them on — so the first approval your organisation sees is the smallest one that works.

item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.16
item.description:
1.0.0-beta.16

Fixed

  • Setup → Calendar: one Allow now flips the row. The OS's answer is trusted instead of a status read that lagged it.
  • Microsoft 365: a refusal is worded honestly (cancelled, or your organisation must approve Scribio once) and the IT approval link is offered from setup.
  • Updates: this is the first build that can receive updates. Every earlier build shipped without its update configuration, so install this one from the DMG — the next release arrives through Check for Updates.

New

  • Setup asks once how Scribio updates itself: automatic checks (on) and beta updates (off).
